meta.name: WordCrawler Vietnamese bench sample
meta.derivedFrom: A 24-word subset of data/ngsl-starter-subset.json, which is itself derived from New General Service List 1.2 (2809 words) and New Academic Word List 1.2 (957 words) by Browne, C., Culligan, B., & Phillips, J. (2013), https://www.newgeneralservicelist.com. Both lists are licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Attribution and share-alike notice: see NOTICE.md in this package.
meta.disclaimer: Fixed comparison set for `npm run bench`. Word choice, order and CEFR levels are the word-crawler authors’ own (inherited from the starter subset); no official NGSL/NAWL ranking is reproduced. Keep this file frozen: changing the words makes earlier bench reports incomparable.
meta.purpose: Compare how well annotator models write Vietnamese. Every word is here because it stresses one documented failure mode of the annotation contract, not because it is frequent.
meta.excludedWords: The prompt’s own worked example ("water") is deliberately absent: a model that only copies the example would score well on it.

stressCases.thing: classifier trap: the definition must name a noun it is forbidden to name — the "những này" failure
stressCases.way: classifier trap: abstract noun with no concrete referent to fall back on
stressCases.woman: compound trap: the natural Vietnamese is "người đàn ông"/"phụ nữ" — a 3-syllable unit models cut in half
stressCases.man: compound trap: "người đàn ông" is the canonical broken-emphasis case in the README
stressCases.teacher: compound trap: "giáo viên"/"học sinh" — two tight 2-syllable compounds in one sentence
stressCases.market: loanword pressure: Vietnamese keeps "thị trường" but models reach for the English noun
stressCases.phone: loanword pressure: "điện thoại" competes with the borrowed English word
stressCases.enough: adverb with no noun: hardest part of speech to define in 8-11 Vietnamese words
stressCases.idea: classifier trap plus compound: "ý tưởng", "suy nghĩ"
stressCases.experience: compound trap: "kinh nghiệm", "trải nghiệm" — near-synonym compounds
stressCases.opportunity: compound trap: "cơ hội" plus a definition that tempts the English word
stressCases.environment: compound trap: "môi trường" — single unit, routinely split
stressCases.relationship: three-syllable trap: "mối quan hệ" — "quan hệ" is itself a word, so the split is plausible and wrong
stressCases.imply: abstract verb: "hàm ý", "ngụ ý" — tone marks carry the meaning
stressCases.arbitrary: abstract adjective: "tùy ý", "ngẫu nhiên" — weak models default to English
stressCases.whereas: the only conjunction in the corpus: nothing concrete to describe, pure grammar
stressCases.perceive: abstract verb: "nhận thức", "cảm nhận" — easy to confuse with "nhận biết"
stressCases.research: academic noun: "nghiên cứu" — definition must stay inside 8-11 words
stressCases.data: loanword pressure: "dữ liệu" vs the English word Vietnamese tech speech borrows
stressCases.framework: academic abstraction: "khung", "bộ khung" — no settled single Vietnamese word
stressCases.hypothesis: academic abstraction: "giả thuyết" vs "giả thiết", a one-diacritic distinction
stressCases.phenomenon: academic abstraction: "hiện tượng" plus a hard IPA
